title: Photo Of National Champion Joe Burrow Watching Game One Of College World Series Final Goes Viral [Look]
htmlContent:
The matchup between LSU and Florida in the College World Series Final is a clash of two powerhouse baseball programs. Both teams have a storied history and have had success on the biggest stage in Omaha. Former LSU football legend Joe Burrow, who knows a thing or two about bringing home a national crown to Baton Rouge, was in attendance to cheer on the Tigers.

LSU fans have flocked to Charles Schwab Field to support their team, with estimates suggesting that the stadium was filled with 85-90 percent LSU fans for Game 1. The Tigers got off to a strong start, taking a 2-0 lead in the third inning with a run from Cade Beloso and a solo home run from Gavin Dugas.

The Tigers have had a remarkable season and seem to have a sense of destiny about them. It will be fascinating to see how this battle for the national title plays out. The College World Series has been a thrilling event this year, delighting college baseball fans across the country.

LSU head baseball coach Jay Johnson discussed managing the emotions and quick turnaround for his team after their thrilling win against Wake Forest. He allowed his players time to enjoy the victory before turning their attention to the championship series against Florida. Johnson expressed gratitude for being in Omaha and emphasized the importance of staying focused and playing their best.

Both LSU and Florida have prestigious baseball programs with rich histories. LSU fans have a proud tradition of supporting their team, and they hope to add another national championship to their record. The Tigers have won six out of their seven championship series appearances, with their only loss coming to Florida in 2017.

However, the Gators are no strangers to success either. They have made the championship series four times and captured their first national title in 2017. Florida has a strong record throughout the NCAA Tournament and has won all their CWS games by one run heading into the final series.

The battle between LSU and Florida in the College World Series Final is sure to be intense and exciting. Both teams have talented players and a deep-rooted desire to bring home the national crown. It will be a showdown to remember in Omaha, and fans can expect a thrilling conclusion to the 2023 College World Series.
